Column names are nonempty strings without dots and type is int or str;row objects have exactly the declared columns,with exact integers (not booleans),strings,or null. Null is allowed in either type. Duplicate JSON object keys are errors. Repeated identical rows are valid and significant. The files README.md,language.json and pack.json are protected inputs:preserve their bytes. Plans use exactly these operators/keys:

- {op:"filter",input:PLAN,predicate:P}. Keep only rows for which P is true;false and unknown are discarded.
- {op:"project",input:PLAN,fields:{OUTPUT_NAME:EXPR,...}}. Evaluate all fields against each input row. Bag duplicates survive.
- {op:"join",kind:"inner"|"left",left:PLAN,right:PLAN,left_on:LEFT_FIELD,right_on:RIGHT_FIELD}. Equijoin using equally typed fields. Null never equals null. Preserve every matching pair and duplicates. LEFT JOIN adds exactly one null-filled right-side row for each unmatched left occurrence. The complete right schema exists even when right has no rows.
- {op:"group",input:PLAN,keys:[FIELD,...],aggregates:{OUTPUT_NAME:AGG,...}}. Keys are existing unique fields;aggregate names do not collide with keys. Null keys belong to the same group. AGG is {fn:"count_all"}, {fn:"count",expr:EXPR},or {fn:"sum",expr:EXPR}. count_all counts rows;count counts nonnull expression values;sum adds exact integer nonnull values and returns null if none. Global aggregation (keys:[]) over zero rows returns one row with count0/sum null;keyed aggregation over zero rows returns no rows. Project/group outputs may be referenced as columns by later nodes. No implicit rounding or distinct elimination.

EXPR is exactly {col:FIELD}, {lit:INTEGER|STRING|null}, {add:[EXPR,EXPR]},or {sub:[EXPR,EXPR]}. Arithmetic requires integers and propagates null. P is {eq|ne|lt|le|gt|ge:[EXPR,EXPR]}, {is_null:EXPR}, {not:P},or {and|or:[P,P,...]} (at least2). Comparisons require matching int/string types;any null operand gives unknown.
